dedupe_keys.name: national high resolution cropland classification of japan with agricultural census samples 2015

description: This dataset maps nine crop types across Japan for 2015, around 31 million parcels, using training samples drawn from the 2015 agricultural census. The Zenodo record says Sentinel-1 and Landsat-8 were combined into monthly, bimonthly and seasonal composites by prefecture because Sentinel-2 was not yet available, deep learning models were trained on census-derived samples, and the result reached 87 percent overall accuracy for nine classes over 47 prefectures. It was published in January 2023 by a research team of four authors under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 4.4 GB. Coverage is Japan. Caveats: the file format and class list are not stated on the page read, and the map reflects 2015. For simulation it gives parcel-level crop exposure for typhoon, flood and earthquake loss models of Japanese agriculture. Related catalogue records include the FAO cropland agreement map and the WorldCereal harmonized reference data.
name: National high-resolution cropland classification of Japan with agricultural census samples (2015)
provider: Junshi Xia, Naoto Yokoya, Bruno Adriano and Kanemoto (research team), via Zenodo
